faq.q: How do Maple Ridge townhome buyers commute?
faq.a: The West Coast Express runs weekday trains between Waterfront (downtown Vancouver) and Mission City, stopping at Port Haney Station (22300 River Road), with Maple Meadows Station serving the city's west side; Haney Place Exchange is the bus hub, including the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus to Coquitlam Central Station.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Maple Ridge is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
